name: your domain
headline: Your *domain*, your rules
sub: Sovereignty is hosting your own domain and content.
say: Your domain is your front door. Hypercomb takes you there in steps: start in your browser, share through a friend's host, then run your own host under your own domain. The people who follow your domain get your work straight from you, and your community can connect to the communities it cares about most, domain to domain. No platform stands between you and the people you choose.
